prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel RPG animation sprite sheet, transparent background. Reference image is ONLY character identity/outfit/style, not its poses. Draw the same adult silver-haired male hero, navy tunic, cream short shoulder mantle, teal sash, dark trousers, brown boots, in a true TWO-HANDED OVERHEAD GREAT SWORD CHOP. Exactly 7 COLUMNS chronological attack phases left to right and exactly 5 ROWS camera directions top to bottom: front facing viewer; left profile facing left; back facing away; front-left three-quarter; back-left three-quarter. 35 separate full-body figures evenly spaced in grid, no labels. Every figure BOTH hands visibly grasp ONE shared long handle with stacked fists, both elbows and arms attached naturally to shoulders. Every figure holds a temporary guide sword: straight SOLID BRIGHT MAGENTA blade, fluorescent LIME GREEN long grip/handle, small lime guard. These colors are registration markers and must be perfectly flat, no glowing effects. Blade tip extends away from guard, two hands wrap lime grip below guard. Do NOT draw any final silver blade or effects. Animation columns: 1 both hands gripping handle in front of chest, blade upward, ready stance; 2 both elbows rise symmetrically, hands just above forehead, blade upward behind crown; 3 fully raised two-handed overhead preparation, both fists above crown, blade points straight up slightly back, feet braced; 4 begin decisive downward chop, BOTH arms drive forward/down together, hands in front of face, head dips; 5 heavy impact, BOTH hands lowered in front of waist, sword blade points down toward ground in front, torso folded forward, knees bent and lead foot planted; 6 follow through both hands still LOW near leading knee, blade down, weight forward; 7 recover hands toward lower chest, blade rising, body straightening. No horizontal swipe, no one-handed raised arm, no arm left at hip, no waving, no spin, no circular trails. Keep same head size and body proportions as reference, face clear between arms, full head attached to neck, torso actually leans in phases4-6. Carefully draw real pixel clusters, clean hard edges, all feet visible, ample transparent margins around raised sword; no ground shadows. Wide landscape sheet about 7:5 aspect ratio. Each cell identical size and consistent feet baseline. Pose clarity and BOTH HANDS SAME HANDLE are the highest priority.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this isolated pixel fantasy sword. Preserve silver blade with blue fuller, crescent gold crossguard and blue central gem, dark leather, pommel design. Make the black leather HANDLE a proper TWO-HANDED long grip, long enough for two adult fists stacked along its shaft. Change relative dimensions: straight blade from tip to guard occupies 63 percent of total length, grip from guard to pommel occupies 30 percent, pommel 7 percent. Thin elegant longsword, not a giant wide greatsword. Perfectly vertical tip at top pommel bottom, center shaft, transparent background. One sword only, no hands, text, effects or backdrop. Crisp sharp real pixel art and clean hard alpha, balanced game equipment icon.
